device.description: 12-bit 40 kSPS low-power sampling ADC with internal reference, byte-wide parallel and serial outputs
device.note: ads7806.pdf (SBAS021B) p.2-3 specifications (conversion time 20 us, VIH, data format, VDIG 4.75-5.25 V), p.4 pin descriptions, pin configuration and Table I input ranges, p.7 basic operation, p.8 Tables II-IV (control functions, output codes), p.9 reading data and Figures 2-3, p.10 Table V timing

commands.name: Convert (CS and R/C low)
commands.note: p.8 Table II: CS falling with R/C low, or R/C falling with CS low, starts conversion n; commands are ignored while BUSY is low

pages: p.2 (conversion time 20 us, input ranges +/-10 V, 0-5 V, 0-4 V), p.3 (VIH 2.0 V to VD+0.3 V, bus access/relinquish 83 ns, VDIG/VANA 4.75-5.25 V), p.4 (pin descriptions: D7-D0 MSB byte when BYTE low, D3..D0 low on the LSB byte; pin configuration; Table I), p.8 (Table II control functions, Table IV codes: BTC 0 V = 000h, SB 0 V = 800h on +/-10 V), p.9 (parallel output, Figures 2-3), p.10 (Table V: t4 BUSY low 20 us max, t9 83 ns, t12 83 ns)
notModeled: analog inputs, input-range resistor network (R1IN/R2IN wiring), internal reference (REF output, REFD shuts it down), CAP buffer

codeFormat assumes the +/-10 V range (Figure 1a, the first in Table I): SB/BTC high gives offset binary (0 V = 800h), low two's complement (000h). On the unipolar 0-5 V / 0-4 V ranges the 0 V input is -full scale (SB 000h, BTC 800h), which the model does not give
serial output (SDATA, DATACLK internal/external clock per EXT/INT, TAG daisy-chain input): SDATA and DATACLK are never driven; only the parallel port is modeled

the conversion starts when the CS/R/C low period ends (write access end) rather than at its falling edge; the 40 ns - 12 us convert pulse width and the rule that CS or R/C must be high before BUSY rises (else a conversion restarts without acquisition) are not checked
reading during a conversion returns the previous result (valid up to 12 us after the start); the model keeps the same 0 V code throughout
PWRD (analog power-down; digital stays active, conversions invalid) is not read
VDIG must be <= VANA; acquisition time and 40 kHz throughput limits
variants: ADS7806PB/UB are higher grades of the same part (same spec).
